campus_meta.name: Manav Rachna Educational Institutions (MREI) - Smart Campus
campus_meta.institution: Manav Rachna International Institute of Research and Studies (MRIIRS) & Manav Rachna University (MRU)
campus_meta.location: Sector 43, Aravalli Hills, Delhi-Surajkund Road, Faridabad, Haryana

zones.name: Dr. O.P. Bhalla Central Commons & Peace Hall

nodes.name: Main University Gate (Gate No. 1)
nodes.description: Primary university portal on Delhi-Surajkund Road with transit booth, security pavilion, visitor reception, and parking.

nodes.name: Block A - Founder's & Administrative Block
nodes.description: Vice-Chancellor Secretariat, Registrar Office, Central Admissions Bureau, Examination Wing, and Corporate Relations.

nodes.name: Dr. O.P. Bhalla Central Library (Block B)
nodes.zone: Dr. O.P. Bhalla Central Commons & Peace Hall
nodes.description: Four-level central digital knowledge repository with 200k+ volumes, IEEE digital access pods, research cubicles, and 24-hr study hall.

nodes.name: Block C - Faculty of Engineering & Technology (FET / CSE)
nodes.description: Department of Computer Science & Engineering, AI/ML Supercomputing GPU clusters, Cyber Security Lab, and Cloud Computing Arena.

nodes.name: Block E - Electronics & Electrical Engineering
nodes.description: VLSI Design suites, Embedded IoT Systems Lab, Smart Grid micro-turbines, and RF Microwave measurement facilities.

nodes.name: Block D - Mechanical & Automotive Center
nodes.description: Robotics makerspace, CNC machining bays, Daikin Air-Conditioning Centre of Excellence, and SAE Collegiate Baja garage.

nodes.name: Dr. O.P. Bhalla Memorial Auditorium (Peace Hall)
nodes.zone: Dr. O.P. Bhalla Central Commons & Peace Hall
nodes.description: 1,500-seat acoustic amphitheater and auditorium hosting convocations, national academic conclaves, and cultural fest Resurrection.

nodes.name: Central Food Court & Student Cafe (Hunger Cure)
nodes.zone: Dr. O.P. Bhalla Central Commons & Peace Hall
nodes.description: Multi-outlet campus food court featuring Subway, Nescafe corner, open cafeteria seating, and student central square.

nodes.name: Student Activity Centre & Clan Hub (Block F/G)
nodes.zone: Dr. O.P. Bhalla Central Commons & Peace Hall
nodes.description: Headquarters for Student Council, Manav Rachna Clan activities, music and dance studios, media room, and indoor recreation.

nodes.name: Manav Rachna Sports Academy & Shooting Range
nodes.description: World-class 10m/25m/50m indoor shooting range (home of Olympic medalists), indoor badminton, synthetic basketball courts, and cricket arena.

nodes.name: Boys Campus Residence (Hostel Block)
nodes.description: Multi-storey air-conditioned boys student residential towers with study lounges, indoor gym, and mess dining.

nodes.name: Girls Campus Residence (Hostel Block)
nodes.description: Dedicated secure on-campus girls residence complex with private landscaped courtyard, medical annex, and recreation hall.

nodes.name: MRIIRS Health & Wellness Centre
nodes.description: 24/7 campus medical clinic, dental hospital & consultation wing, emergency ambulance bay, and counseling cell.

nodes.name: MRIIC - Innovation & Incubation Centre
nodes.description: Manav Rachna Innovation and Incubation Centre (MRIIC), NewGen IEDC, patent facilitation bureau, and tech startup accelerators.

nodes.name: Aravalli Nature Trail & Herbal Garden
nodes.description: Scenic hillside nature trail through Aravalli biodiversity foliage with stone steps and herbal medicine garden. (Steps only - not wheelchair accessible).

nodes.name: North Gate 2 (Aravalli Campus Transit)
nodes.description: Northern campus access connected to university shuttle fleet, Surajkund-Badkhal highway, and metro feeder buses.
